title: Total gross foreign investment inflows
caution: Provisional last period; gross inflows, not net FDI. No causal attribution to one government.

title: Extreme poverty, legacy $2.15 line (2017 PPP)
caution: World Bank harmonized historical 2011–12 MMRP survey; do not mix with newer 2021 PPP poverty line. Pre-2014 to post-2014 comparison is not attribution.

title: Rural monthly real consumption per person
caution: HCES method differs between older and newer surveys; cross-period comparability cannot be treated as exact.

title: Urban monthly real consumption per person
caution: HCES method differs between rounds, so this is indicative rather than fully harmonised.

title: Rural monthly nominal consumption per person
caution: Current-price comparison, not real spending power.

title: Urban monthly nominal consumption per person
caution: Current-price comparison, not real spending power.

title: Headline CPI inflation (revised base)
caution: September provisional, August final; 2024=100 CPI; monthly change in annual inflation rates, not change in CPI price level.

title: Food inflation (revised base)
caution: September provisional, August final; 2024=100 base; this is monthly change in year-on-year food inflation.
